title: silene coeli-rosa
intro: Silene coeli-rosa, commonly known as Skyrocket or Alpine Catchfly, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene coeli-rosa are attributed to its ability to act as an adaptogen, sedative, and anti-anxiety agent, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
